:- use_module(library(clpfd)).
 
% Stack VM
 
% Pushes an integer onto the stack
push(S, I, S1):-
	append(S, [I], S1).
 
% Pops an integer off the stack
pop(S, I, S1):-
	length(S, L),
	L > 0,
	append(_S, [I|S1], S),
	_ is L - 1.
 
% Adds top two integers on the stack
add(S, S1):-
	pop(S, I1, S2),
	pop(S2, I2, S3),
	I is I1 + I2,
	push(S3, I, S1).
 
% Multiplies top two integers on the stack
mul(S, S1):-
	pop(S, I1, S2),
	pop(S2, I2, S3),
	I is I1 * I2,
	push(S3, I, S1).
 
% Duplicates top integer on the stack
dup(S, S1):-
	pop(S, I, S2),
	push(S2, I, S3),
	push(S3, I, S1).
 
% Swaps top two integers on the stack
swap(S, S1):-
	pop(S, I1, S2),
	pop(S2, I2, S3),
	push(S3, I1, S4),
	push(S4, I2, S1).
 
% Prints top integer on the stack
print(S, I, S1):-
	pop(S, I, S1).
 
% Runs a list of instructions on a stack
run([], _, []):-!.
run([push(I)|T], S, S1):-
	push(S, I, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([pop(I)|T], S, S1):-
	pop(S, I, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([add|T], S, S1):-
	add(S, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([mul|T], S, S1):-
	mul(S, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([dup|T], S, S1):-
	dup(S, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([swap|T], S, S1):-
	swap(S, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
run([print(I)|T], S, S1):-
	print(S, I, S2),
	run(T, S2, S1).
